# DM ARRANGIA

> AI-powered music and performance workstation for musicians, arrangers, producers, worship teams, and live performers.

## Product

DM ARRANGIA is a browser-based workstation that combines music arrangement, automatic accompaniment, MIDI control, audio playback, recording, media management, studio tools, worship workflows, and intelligent music assistance.

## Core capabilities

- Arranger workstation for chords, rhythms, variations, fills, intros, and endings
- Live performance controls
- MIDI keyboard and controller support
- Browser-based audio tools
- AI Music Director
- Studio and session tools
- Media player
- Worship-oriented performance tools
- Progressive Web App support
